verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships official SDKs across TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java and YAML with full provider coverage, plus a first-party Automation API that exposes the engine as a programmatic SDK for embedding in custom (including AI-driven) tooling, and an official MCP server for AI assistants to interact with Pulumi resources. This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to build against official, language-native SDKs rather than reverse-engineered wrappers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that all languages are truly 'equally capable' as claimed, and no dedicated AI/agent-specific SDK beyond Automation API + MCP.
